يفتعلون (form VIII)
# يَفْتَعِلُونَ (yaftaʕilūna) /jaf.ta.ʕi.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
# يُفْتَعَلُونَ (yuftaʕalūna) /juf.ta.ʕa.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
